trello.name: Document security incident involving malicious support ticket
trello.desc: Hassan is to write a detailed incident report on the malicious support ticket attempt. This includes capturing the raw ticket content, the summarizer's actual output, relevant timestamps, and a severity assessment. The report must be filed in the security log by the end of this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against injection attacks
trello.desc: Wren will implement a sanitization layer in the ticket parser to delimit quoted customer content and strip or neutralize instruction-like content before it reaches the summarizer. This includes adding delimiters and an instruction-pattern filter. Wren will also create a regression test using the malicious ticket as a test fixture and develop an evaluation suite that runs multiple injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. This task is approved and should be completed as soon as possible to prevent further injection risks.

trello.name: Investigate password reset issue for account jdoe443
trello.desc: Wren will verify if the account 'jdoe443' is a real user by checking reset email delivery logs for the last week. If the account is determined to be a burner, it will be closed; if password resets are found to be broken for any users, this will trigger a separate incident. Wren will follow up with findings accordingly.

trello.name: Provide list of service accounts created since May for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Hassan will compile and submit a list of all service accounts created since May to Grace. This is to support the quarterly access review that Grace will conduct. The list must be delivered by Thursday to allow time for review before the Friday deadline.
